name: postcard
description: Draws each prompt you send as a blue bordered card, each slash command as a purple one, and /prompts lists them in a pane to search, jump to, re-send or edit; /prompts prev and next step between them.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: auto and plain draw the Unicode glyphs (‖ ✕ …) and rounded cards; text draws ASCII stand-ins (| x ~) and classic borders, for a terminal or font that cannot show them. Code keeps its text.
